about: Wheeled vehicles: engine layers by revs (looped, crossfaded and pitched by rpm), starting, stopping, shifting, tyres by surface, brakes, horn, doors, crashes. Every vehicle without its own sounds falls back here.
notes: v2. Engine and roll layers are 20 s beds cut to loop; a car's own engine goes in its own folder.

prompts.text: A small four-cylinder car engine idles steadily at about 900 rpm, recorded from just outside the car, a smooth even burble. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/low.want: the engine at low revs under load

prompts.text: A small four-cylinder car engine holds steady at about 2000 rpm under light load, an even humming drone. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A small four-cylinder car engine holds steady at about 3500 rpm, a strong even growl, constant pitch. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A small four-cylinder car engine holds steady near its redline at about 6000 rpm, a loud straining whine, constant pitch. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

A small four-cylinder car engine is started with a key: the starter motor cranks briefly and it catches and settles to idle, three separate starts with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A small four-cylinder car engine is switched off from idle: it shudders and dies, four separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A small four-cylinder car engine is revved hard once and drops back to idle, four separate revs with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/stall.want: the engine stalling or out of fuel

prompts.text: A small four-cylinder car engine sputters, coughs and stalls, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car engine runs roughly, coughs and splutters, and dies into silence, two separate stalls with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A manual car gearbox shifts gear: a clutch thunk and the lever clicking into place, five separate shifts with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car tyres rolling on smooth asphalt at moderate speed: a steady low rumbling road noise. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car tyres rolling slowly over loose gravel: steady crunching and popping stones. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car tyres rolling on a dry dirt track: a soft steady rumble with small bumps. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car tyres rolling across a grass field: a soft swishing rumble. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car tyres churning slowly through wet mud: squelching sucking sloshes. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car tyres rolling through soft deep sand: a muffled hissing scrunch. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car tyres skid and squeal loudly on asphalt during a hard turn, a long screech, three separate skids with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car slides sideways on gravel: scraping crunching spray of stones, three separate slides with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Car brakes squeal briefly as a car stops, four separate stops with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car handbrake lever is pulled up with a ratcheting click, five separate pulls with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A small car's horn honks, short beeps and one long honk, four separate honks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car door handle is pulled and the door opens with a latch click, four separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car door is shut firmly with a solid thunk, five separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car bumps into something at low speed: a dull crunch of plastic and metal, four separate bumps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car crashes hard at speed: a violent bang of crumpling metal and breaking glass, two separate crashes with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car window shatters: a sharp crack and tinkling falling glass, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car drives over a pothole: a heavy suspension thump and creak, five separate bumps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car's suspension bottoms out over a bump: a deep metallic clunk and a spring creak, five separate bumps with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A car drives fast through a deep puddle: a big rushing splash, three separate splashes with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Wind rushing past a car window at high speed: a steady loud roaring buffet. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
